story.titleZh: 凯迪拉克声明：博塔斯因事故被送往医疗中心进行进一步检查
story.summaryZh: 博塔斯在L46发生事故后，为预防起见被送往医疗中心进行进一步检查。他自行下车，并在无线电中保持清醒。
story.originalTitle: Cadillac statement: "Valtteri Bottas has been taken to the Medical Centre for further medical assessments as a precaution following an incident on L46...
story.summaryEn:
Cadillac statement:
"Valtteri Bottas has been taken to the Medical Centre for further medical assessments as a precaution following an incident on L46. 
"He got out of the car unaided and was responsive on the radio."
#F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
凯迪拉克声明：
"瓦尔特里·博塔斯在L46发生事故后，为了预防措施被送往医疗中心进行进一步医疗评估。
"他自行从车内出来，并在无线电中保持清醒。"
#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
